Native source has one five-section swept core, flat polygon normals, and three separate thin rectangular crack meshes. The abrupt turn creates awkward geometry. Original cracks and part counts have no aesthetic preservation value.
targetObservations: The frozen target proposes broad rounded cyan stone top planes, cobalt lower mass, softened corner transitions, intentional large stone divisions and a few smooth cyan/lavender pebble accents.

The strongest improvements are dimensional softly rounded stone construction, clear bright top versus blue side separation, and restrained crafted detail. The warm-soft plant reference contributes soft light, clear volumes and controlled highlights, not its green/orange palette.
The raw target is a style/design reference; its apparent height, transparency fringe, local flare, decorative size and image placement are not native contract evidence.
